deploy-bot: [canary] rollout 3.14.0 -> region=us-west-2 traffic=10% p50=108ms p95=540ms errors=0.9% (thresholds: p95=400ms errors=0.6%) -> recommend: STAGE_PIN canary
ellie: saw the spike, looks correlated with kv_cache_v2 kernel flag flip earlier in the job log
marta: grabbing traces now, initial top spans show retry loops around KV reads
sanjay: if it's kv cache, we should pin canary back to 3.13.8 and pause further traffic shifts
kevin: agree. propose staged exit: pin only canary (keep prod traffic unchanged), call oncall to lead verification, then either unpin or roll forward with a patch
oncall-sre: I'm on it, will take the pager. ellie, paste rollback command?
ellie: rollback command we use for targeted canary pin: ```/deploy rollback --service=inference --to=3.13.8 --scope=canary```
deploy-bot: executing: applying pin -> service=inference target=3.13.8 scope=canary by=ellie (job id 9843f)
marta: confirmed pin applied, canary traffic frozen at 0% shift, artifacts pinned to 3.13.8
sanjay: running canary smoke tests against pinned instance now (smoke-suite: inference-smoke v2) ETA ~7m
kevin: I'll assemble quick checklist for pager handoff: 1) verify p95 < 200ms 2) error < 0.5% 3) no 5xx traces 4) confirm KV hit rate restored
deploy-bot: smoke tests run result: PASS (all checks) p95=118ms errors=0.18%
oncall-sre: looks good on metrics and traces, KV hit rate back to normal. recommendation: prepare patch build with kv_cache_v2 disabled and attempt a controlled retry rather than full revert
ellie: drafting release note snippet: "Canary for 3.14.0 paused and pinned to previous stable (3.13.8) after p95 regression linked to experimental kv cache flag. No customer-facing impact. Team is cutting 3.14.1 with flag disabled and will resume canary."
marta: cutting branch/3.14.1 with kernel flag off, building image now. will push canary to 5% once image ready
sanjay: add a line to internal rollout playbook: timeline of pin (start: 2026-04-03T12:30Z), smoke pass (12:38Z), decision to patch (12:44Z)
kevin: comms plan: post short note in #customer-comm and pin a one-paragraph incident note in #releases, cc: sales-eng for any flagged customers. ellie can you send?
ellie: sending both now, will paste copy here for signoff
ellie: "Heads up: small canary pause and targeted rollback for 3.14.0 in us-west-2. No customer impact. Team is testing 3.14.1 with a mitigant and will resume rollout once verified. Full notes in #releases."
oncall-sre: patch image available, deploy-bot starting canary 3.14.1 -> 5%
deploy-bot: canary 3.14.1 started -> region=us-west-2 traffic=5% p50=112ms p95=150ms errors=0.2%
marta: monitoring heatmaps, p95 stable and traces clean. recommending unpin and continue staged rollout after 30m watch
sanjay: planning to unpin at 12:50Z and let rollout continue to 20% then 50% with normal deploy-bot cadence
e llie: small note for release notes: include rollback rationale, kernel flag root cause, and the fixed image 3.14.1 SHA 9f2a7c
kevin: nice. after we finish watch window please update release notes section "canary rollback" with timeline and remediation steps
deploy-bot: removing pin -> canary unpinned by ellie (job id 9843f)
oncall-sre: handoff: monitoring until 13:20Z then handing pager back to rotation. thanks team :thumbsup:
